name: mcq-engine
description: Static web app for practising multiple-choice exam papers. No build step.

scripts.sample: python3 tests/make_fixture.py build/fixture && python3 tools/mcqpack.py extract --profile profiles/cie-mcq-v1.json --paper build/fixture/paper.pdf --scheme build/fixture/scheme.pdf --id sample-physics --title "Synthetic Physics (sample)" --out packs/sample-physics && python3 tools/mcqpack.py merge packs/sample-physics/pack.json packs/sample-physics-structured.json && python3 tools/mcqpack.py validate packs/sample-physics
